title: Sizing the Next Subsidy Funding Lot a Client Pays into a Micro Market
content:
The lot a client of the Unattended Micro Market Program pays in is the subsidy the cover period is expected to need, less the share of the funding still drawable that is set against it, plus the handling step.

## The calculation

The expected need for one month is the badged headcount the site reports multiplied by the subsidy allowed for one employee for one month and by the take-up share; the cover need is that monthly figure multiplied by the cover months and then raised once by the contingency share, the contingency acting on the whole cover need rather than on the monthly figure; the drawable share is taken off the cover need, and the handling step is added to what is left.

The funding still drawable, the expected need for one month, the cover need and the lot are each rounded to the nearest cent as they are taken, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent.

The funding still drawable is what was paid in over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, less what has been drawn at the kiosk over those same twelve months, less what has been handed back to the client on a settlement, being the credits standing on the agreement that name no kiosk, and never below nothing.

Where the lot so worked out falls below the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, no lot is taken and the client is asked to combine the amount into the next one.

## The quantities

The subsidy allowed for one employee for one month is 20.00 USD. The cover period is the standard cover of 3 months. The take-up share is the standing take-up of 25 per cent. The contingency share is the standing contingency of 10 per cent. The whole of the funding still drawable is set against the cover need. No handling step is added.

## A lot worked through

*Hypothetical inputs.* The site reports a badged headcount of 520. Over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, 8000.00 USD of subsidy funding was paid in and 5200.00 USD was drawn at the kiosk, and credits naming no kiosk standing on the agreement total 480.00 USD. The market format prints a minimum funding lot of 4200.00 USD.

The expected need for one month is 2600.00 USD, being 520 multiplied by 20.00 USD and by 25 per cent. The cover need is 8580.00 USD, being 2600.00 USD multiplied by 3 months and then raised once by 10 per cent. The funding still drawable is 2320.00 USD. The whole of it is set against the cover need, leaving 6260.00 USD, and no handling step is added, so the lot is 6260.00 USD. That figure is at or above the printed minimum funding lot of 4200.00 USD.

*Hypothetical inputs, second case.* On a site reporting a badged headcount of 200, the expected need for one month is 1000.00 USD and the cover need 3300.00 USD; with the same 2320.00 USD of funding still drawable set against it and no handling step, the figure comes to 980.00 USD, which falls below the printed minimum funding lot of 4200.00 USD, so no lot is taken and the client is asked to combine the amount into the next one.
